hooks.command: echo '📝 Code changed - consider running testing-agent next'

hooks.prompt: Run TWO checks on this session. (1) TESTS: if code was written (Edit/Write on .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.prisma) but tests were not run afterward, that is a failure. (2) DECISIONS: if the session made or uncovered a durable decision the code cannot express — a business rule + its rationale, a deliberately rejected alternative, a threshold/cadence chosen for a reason, a scope exclusion, or non-obvious edge-case handling — AND it was NOT persisted to a memory file or docs/decisions.md this session, that is a failure. Purely mechanical work (renames, styling tweaks, obvious bug fixes, no judgment calls) has no decision to capture and passes. If both checks pass, respond: {"ok": true}. If either fails, respond: {"ok": false, "reason": "<which check(s) failed and what to do>"}. Respond ONLY with valid JSON.
